column4: dialect-gated: a single flat CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL gate -- testutil.TestDB(t, DialectMSSQL) skips ONCE and there are no t.Run subtests -- so it costs one skip in this PostgreSQL-only job. Guards cleat#2342: a SQL Server SECURITY POLICY is a separate object holding a dependency on the table it filters, so RunDownMigrations' old order (run the Down SQL, which drops the table) failed with Msg 3729 before ever reaching a policy drop, because there was none; unapplyTenantScoping now drops the policy first. Only test-go/support carries a line because ./plugin/... is in that package group and the cluster job runs ./engine/... only, not this package. Measured by name: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./plugin/ -run TestRunDownMigrationsDropsMSSQLSecurityPolicyBeforeTheTable -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly one.
